opening.argument: The speaker introduces the video as advice on how students can earn money, then offers skills and ideas they can use from home. The concrete examples are ordinary services: creative gift wrapping and tutoring in a subject the student knows. That is an educational discussion of ways to earn through work, not a specified investment return or guaranteed profit. The cited examples do not require students to participate financially. A separate screen-recorder promotion does not, on this evidence, establish a connection to the student-income advice or a harmful mechanism.
